item.title: Police vow to unravel disappearance of woman after visiting boyfriend in Lagos
item.description: Lagos State Police Command has reaffirmed its commitment to uncovering the circumstances surrounding the disappearance of a young woman, Comfort Uwakwe, who has been missing since visiting her boyfriend in the Epe area of the state. The command’s spokesperson, Abimbola Adebisi, gave the assurance on Sunday while responding to growing concerns raised by Comfort’s family […] Police vow to unravel disappearance of woman after visiting boyfriend in Lagos

item.title: EPL: Neville suggests two best managers to replace Carrick after win over Arsenal
item.description: Former Manchester United captain, Gary Neville has named two managers to replace interim coach, Michael Carrick at the end of the season after the Red Devils defeated Arsenal 3-2 on Sunday at Emirates Stadium. item.title: LIRS asks Nigerian banks to debit employers’ accounts over failure to remit tax
item.description: The Lagos Internal Revenue Service, pursuant to Section 60 of the Nigeria Tax Administration Act, plans to ask Nigerian banks to debit bank accounts of employers who failed to remit tax liability. This was disclosed in a recent notice sighted by DAILY POST on Sunday. item.title: ‘I’m not perfect’ – Ex-Speaker Dogara on accepting to be Tinubu’s running mate in 2027
item.description: Former Speaker of the House of Representatives, Yakubu Dogara, has reacted to speculations about accepting to become President Bola Tinubu’s running mate in the 2027 general election. item.title: Nigerian govt clarifies ban on use of native languages in schools

item.title: Police arrest man over alleged N5.2m fake job scam in Kebbi
item.description: The Kebbi State Police Command has arrested a man, Hamza Sama, over an alleged employment scam involving more than 175 job seekers in the state. Police said the suspect, who resides in the KCC area of Birnin Kebbi, allegedly collected money from victims under the guise of securing jobs in the state’s school feeding programme […] Police arrest man over alleged N5.2m fake job scam in Kebbi

item.title: Lagos demolitions: Falana calls for immediate halt, cites court orders
item.description: Human rights lawyer, Femi Falana, SAN, has urged the Lagos State Government to immediately suspend what he described as unlawful and unconstitutional demolitions of waterfront properties across the state, warning that the actions amount to executive overreach and contempt of court. Falana made the call in a statement, referencing a series of existing court orders […] Lagos demolitions: Falana calls for immediate halt, cites court orders

item.title: Obi Cubana reveals current most important assignment amid backlash over APC appointment

item.title: Venezuela frees 80 political prisoners amid US pressure
